input.quote: 10.8 Headings; Counterparts. The section headings in this Agreement are for reference purposes only and shall not define, limit or affect the meaning or interpretation of this Agreement.
input.rationale: No insurance provision appears anywhere in the Agreement (searches for "insurance" and "indemn" return nothing, and Section 10 General Provisions ends at 10.8 Headings; Counterparts). HDI is a hosting/services vendor: it stores and operates the Site on its systems (1.4), processes customer orders and export files (1.5, 2.2), and has access to Content, user information and data (8.1). Under the playbook this warrants standard vendor coverage, so we insert a new Section 10.9 requiring CGL of USD 1M/2M, E&O of USD 2M, cyber liability of USD 5M and statutory workers' compensation, with certificates on request. Placed in the general provisions section, which also survives termination for two years under 10.7. Fallback of E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert insurance covenant (CGL, E&O, cyber, workers' comp) as new Section 10.9
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no insurance requirement even though HDI hosts the Site and handles customer orders and user data, so we have added a standard coverage covenant (general liability, errors and omissions, cyber liability and statutory workers' compensation) with certificates on request. If the cyber limit is an issue, we can accept E&O of USD 1,000,000 and cyber liability of USD 2,000,000.

ops.text: 10.9 Insurance. HDI shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: (a) commercial general liability insurance of not less than $1,000,000 per occurrence and $2,000,000 in the aggregate; (b) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than $2,000,000; (c) cyber liability insurance of not less than $5,000,000 covering HDI's processing of Confidential Information, Content and customer or user data; and (d) workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. HDI shall provide the Company with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage upon request.
